title: Step 12 — the responder locks 37,000 tCeBM on spoke-pen, timelock now+1800
description: Banco de Lima locks the PEN leg against the SAME hash_lock, received from the initiator out-of-band. No secret is generated or stored on this spoke.
notes: Gateway: Banco de Lima commercial-bank gateway (spoke-pen). Locked at 2026-06-18T10:20:00Z, time_lock 1781779800 = 2026-06-18T10:50:00Z (now+1800, the default) — deliberately SHORTER than the initiator's 1781781300, so the responder can reclaim its tokens first if settlement stalls. The hash_lock crosses from step 11 to here out-of-band: there is no API endpoint for that transfer anywhere on the platform. The gateway hex-decodes hash_lock and answers 400 'hash_lock must be a 64-char hex string (32 bytes)' for anything else.
